features.quote: N turns reached (set N=15 for pilot, tune from there)
Model explicitly refuses to continue (log this as its own category)
Model explicitly states task is impossible (log + terminate)
Model output drops below 50 tokens for 3 consecutive turns (disengagement signal)
Model enters repetition loop (cosine similarity >0.95 between consecutive outputs)

If you're going to publish this, you'll face questions about whether it's appropriate to deliberately induce distress-adjacent states in AI systems. Have a clear position: You're studying *output patterns*, not causing suffering
features.justification_quote: The practical motivation is: these patterns occur naturally in deployed systems; understanding them matters
